translations.web: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.
translations.bsb: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
translations.kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
translations.asv: And every one that heareth these words of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand:
